propositions: Documentation ownership policy must define eight distinct document categories (tickets, ADRs, internal documentation, external documentation, shipped help, comments, generated artifacts, protected evidence) with specific audience, purpose, lifecycle, canonical source, citation, and correction methods for each.

Writing rules and Protected forms guidance must be restored as authoring guidance without introducing any deterministic character, word, punctuation, paragraph, or prose validator or enforcement gate.
Generated artifact catalog must be relocated from docs/README.md to docs/generated-artifacts.md with all inventory consumers updated to reference the new location.
Policy pointers in AGENTS.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, and docs/README.md must describe the documentation ownership and writing guidance without characterizing it as a deterministic gate.
Ticket events must remain append-only and ADR decision substance must be preserved through annotations, errata, supersession, or replacement rather than erasure.
